## Microsoft Power Automate

Microsoft Power Automate is a natural UiPath alternative for Microsoft centric enterprises. It combines cloud flows, desktop flows, Copilot assistance, and Microsoft ecosystem integration, making it attractive for teams that want automation tightly connected to Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform.

## Workato

Workato is an integration and workflow automation platform that has become increasingly relevant to agentic process automation. Its strength is not classic desktop RPA. It is orchestration across SaaS apps, APIs, and enterprise systems, now extended into AI and enterprise MCP style workflows.

# 9 Best UiPath Alternatives in 2026

Elementum Team••Buyer Guides

9 Best UiPath Alternatives in 2026

A UiPath replacement review usually starts when automation teams hit the same three problems at once: brittle UI automations, rising licensing costs, and pressure to add AI without losing governance.

UiPath built a large robotic process automation (RPA) base in the enterprise market, but the cracks tend to show in the same places. Automation suites break when vendors push routine updates, licensing fees come under repeated scrutiny, and logic stored in proprietary formats is difficult to export without rebuilding. [...] On top of that, UiPath itself is mid-transition from RPA specialist to agentic AI offering. Most customers are still running heavy RPA workloads while governance tooling continues to mature, leaving teams managing the old footprint and the new direction simultaneously. Chief Information Officers (CIOs) deciding whether to renew, expand, or replace their UiPath investment need to match the right tool to the right problem: UI automation, cross-system integration, governed AI orchestration, or a combination of these. The nine alternatives below cover each of these paths, with notes on where each one fits best.

## Why CIOs Are Evaluating UiPath Alternatives [...] ## The 9 Best UiPath Alternatives for Enterprise IT

These nine options range from direct RPA replacements to orchestration layers built for AI-heavy workflows.

### 1. Elementum

Elementum is an AI workflow orchestration platform. Most UiPath alternatives on this list start with screen-level automation or assume the enterprise will standardize on a single suite and layer AI inside it.
